surface_name: Drive API and Sheets API with a service account
title: Service account cannot create a Google Sheet or upload a file: 403 storageQuotaExceeded
symptoms: 403 The caller does not have permission (Sheets API create)
Fails even for a 4 byte file
cause: Service accounts have a Drive storage quota of zero. Neither error message says so, and enabling more APIs or granting more IAM roles never helps. A service account can still create folders and write values into a Sheet a human already owns.
fix: Use an OAuth refresh token for a real user whenever an agent must create files. Keep the service account for pure value writes into existing Sheets.
apply: GET https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/about?fields=storageQuota as the service account returns limit "0"
affected: Google Drive API v3 and Sheets API v4, August 2026
